text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 170, October 18, 1938 ]
AMENDING PARAGRAPH (2) OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 161, DATED AUGUST 23, 1938,
ENTITLED “PROMULGATING REGULATIONS TO GOVERN THE ADMINISTRATION AND
COLLECTION OF DELINQUENT IRRIGATION FEES FROM LANDOWNERS UNDER IRRIGATION
SYSTEMS CONSTRUCTED UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF ACT NO. 2152, AS AMENDED, FIXING
ADJUSTED IRRIGATION FEES FOR SAID SYSTEMS AND PRESCRIBING THE MANNER OF
COLLECTING SAME, AND REVOKING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 142, DATED FEBRUARY 15, 1938"
Paragraph (2) of Executive Order Numbered One hundred sixty-one, dated August twenty-third, nineteen
hundred and thirty-eight, is hereby amended to read as follows:
“(2) Landowners delinquent in the payment of irrigation charges for all years prior to nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven shall be allowed until December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-eight, to pay in full such
charges without penalty, or they may be granted a period of ten years from September first, nineteen hundred
and thirty-eight, within which they shall pay unpaid charges including the penalties and expenses of
publication. In the latter case, payments shall be made in ten equal installments, payable at the same time as
the regular annual irrigation charges and to be collected in the same manner as said annual charges are
collected. Any landowner who after paying one or more installment desires to pay in full the remaining
delinquent charges, may do so without being required to pay the corresponding penalties thereon. The benefits
of these provisions shall be extended only to those landowners who shall have paid their irrigation charges for
the year nineteen hundred and thirty-seven on or before December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and
thirty-eight.”
